scope: The seed 4111 observation in N48 suggested a material circulation before the other paired replays finished. Treat this as a discovery observation. Read all remaining pre-existing registered replays as replication checks without changing masks, times or filters.
balance: At each interval and for each fixed start/end mask and threshold, use the disjoint union of all eligible components as the dense set. Its net I→B conversion is the sum of the corresponding conformation balances. The exact total change of B in the periodic box, minus this sum, is the net conversion in the complement.
diagnostic: For every replicate, report signed I and B crossings and net inside/outside conversion for all four definitions. Count individual intervals and per-history aggregate signs. A circulation signature is positive inward I, negative inward B, positive net I→B in the fixed dense set and negative net I→B in its complement. Retain all cases, including zero and opposite signs. The diagnostic concerns net material and both reaction pathways combined; it does not require a particular trajectory for each molecule.
symmetric_readout: Also report twice the average of the same transfer measurement on the start and end masks. A reversed path swaps the two masks and changes the sign of each integrated flux/conversion; the symmetrized current is odd under time reversal. Its expected value in a stationary detailed-balance path law is zero, even though each individual endpoint mask can give biased finite-time readings.
